order: Stamp a package.json declaring commonjs type into the installed hooks directory on every install, so every hook script keeps CommonJS semantics inside a target whose own root package.json declares module type. Write it right after the core guard is copied and before any pack hooks land, with no hook renames and no reference updates, and remove it on uninstall alongside the other hook files. Keep the write idempotent, so unchanged content stays silent, drifted content is overwritten with a single notice line, and the comparison is CRLF-tolerant so a byte-equivalent stamp from an autocrlf checkout must trigger no notice and must not be rewritten. Widen the stamped gitattributes file to pin JSON to eol=lf, and turn the uninstall-time gitattributes removal into a shape match rather than a byte-exact compare. Add regression coverage pinning each of those behaviors.
claims: The scoping file is stamped before any pack hooks land and removed on uninstall, and the comparison tolerates CRLF, so a byte-equivalent stamp is left alone rather than repaired on every future run. New coverage in tests/frontmatter-lint.test.js pins the module-type install, the guard and doctor surviving it, notices that never double up, the untouched CRLF-mangled stamp, and the shape-matched uninstall. The suite reports OK — 37 passed, 0 failed.
